mapper.select: /* signMapper.selectUser */ SELECT USER_UID AS userUid , PASSWORD AS password , EMAIL AS email , NAME AS name FROM USER WHERE EMAIL = #{email} AND FLAG_DELETED = 'N'

/* signMapper.selectUserByAutologinTokenHash */ SELECT U.USER_UID AS userUid , U.PASSWORD AS password , U.NAME AS name FROM AUTOLOGIN A INNER JOIN USER U ON A.USER_UID = U.USER_UID WHERE A.TOKEN_HASH = #{tokenHash} AND A.EXPIRES_AT_EPOCH >= #{nowEpoch} LIMIT 1
